DOLOMITE CAUSING FLOODS?

Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) Chairman Atty. Don Artes and Manila Mayor Isko Moreno lead the opening of a floodgate and installation of trash traps at the Manila Yacht Club portion of Manila Bay on Wednesday, 16 July 2025, as a solution to mitigate flooding along Roxas Boulevard and the Malate area.

This comes after the MMDA cited the Dolomite Beach project as a major cause of chronic flooding near Manila Bay, especially along Taft Avenue. | John Carlo Magallon

LOOK: Motorists endure bumper to bumper traffic along EDSA in San Juan City on Wednesday, July 16. 

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) partners with Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) to implement the Capacity Enhancement on Traffic management with Improvement of Intelligent Transportation Systems in Metropolitan Manila (MMITS) to ease traffic congestion, enhance road safety, improve transport efficiency in the region, and promote inclusive mobility. 

The MMITS project, set to run for three years, is part of the five-year Action Plan for Traffic Management and marks the MMDA’s second partnership with JICA on traffic management efforts. 

📷: Santi San Juan | MB
